title: When Your Overdramatic Golden Retriever Gets Jealous Over THIS! 😂
description:
I gave a PILLOW a little love and attention… and my overdramatic Golden Retriever Fitz took that VERY personally! 😂🐾

Apparently, cuddling anything other than Fitz is completely unacceptable in this house! From jealous pawing to full-body leaning and practically smothering Mom with affection, Fitz was determined to remind me who's REALLY the favorite.

Who knew a pillow could cause this much drama?! 🤣

Does your dog get jealous when you give something else attention? Tell us in the comments!

Welcome to A Mom With Dogs, where life with Fitz the overdramatic Golden Retriever and Brady the Chocolate Labrador is never boring!
